> First contact with C++98: moving from C to classes, `std::cout` / `std::cin`, string handling with `std::string`, and a small interactive program built around two classes.

---

## 📖 Description

`CPP00` is Module 00 of the 42 **C++ modules**. Every exercise is written in **C++98** and compiled with `c++ -Wall -Wextra -Werror -std=c++98`.

What this module covers:

- Namespaces and `std::` streams (`<iostream>`, `<iomanip>`)
- Classes, constructors/destructors, `private` / `public` members
- Member functions and `const` correctness
- Fixed-size storage (no dynamic allocation in the PhoneBook)
- Input validation on `std::getline`

---

## 🗂️ Exercises

| Directory | Exercise | Executable | Description |
|:---------:|----------|:----------:|-------------|
| `ex00` | Megaphone | `megaphone` | Prints its arguments in upper case (or `* LOUD AND UNBEARABLE FEEDBACK NOISE *` with no arguments). |
| `ex01` | My Awesome PhoneBook | `phonebook` | Interactive phonebook of up to 8 contacts with `ADD`, `SEARCH` and `EXIT`; results are shown in a 10-character-wide table. |

---

## ⚙️ Compilation & Usage

Each exercise is independent and has its own `Makefile`:

```bash
make        # build the executable
make clean  # remove object files
make fclean # remove object files and the executable
make re     # fclean + make
```

**`ex00` — Megaphone**
```bash
cd ex00 && make
./megaphone "shhhhh... I think the students are asleep..."
./megaphone Damnit !
./megaphone
```

**`ex01` — My Awesome PhoneBook**
```bash
cd ex01 && make
./phonebook
```

## 🎯 Key Takeaways

- Writing **classes with a clear public interface** and private state.
- Handling **stream input** safely (EOF, empty lines, invalid indexes).
- Formatting tabular output with `std::setw`.
- Building with the **42 flags** `-Wall -Wextra -Werror -std=c++98`.
